title: Devishi Projects & Infrastructure
description: Enterprise corporate web platform, project portfolio showcase, and client portal engineered for Devishi Infra Projects Limited.
longDescription: Devishi Projects Limited (devishipl.com) is an infrastructure, construction, and project development organization. JiApp engineered their flagship corporate web platform, providing an interactive showcase of ongoing and completed infrastructure developments, investor relations documentation, and a secure client inquiry management system. Built with modern Jamstack architecture and deployed on Cloudflare global edge for lightning-fast sub-second response times.
features: Interactive real estate and infrastructure project showcase
Investor relations, corporate filings & brochure downloads
Automated lead capture & inquiry routing engine
Optimized on Cloudflare edge CDN with 99.9% uptime SLA
Full SEO optimization and structured JSON-LD metadata
